scope: Full engine context initializer with native memory fill, default handlers, parameter setup, configuration selector and string comparison; no injected services. Complete retail RAM/CPU/FPU comparisons. Independent fixed context pointer, nine callback/payload pairs and parameter flags checked with initially unset/existing pointers, context patterns and both FPU banks. Runs REND, HARD and Enable configuration source fixtures for both configuration groups; full retail state comparison verifies alternate selection branches. Alternate configuration values are test mutations, not inferred user-facing settings. Does not implement host exception delivery or game boot.
